hero.title: AI/Fullstack Developer
hero.subtitle: Building scalable AI and web applications with modern technologies

paragraphs.para1: I'm a full-stack engineer focused on AI-native products and high-performance backends. Recent representative projects include an AI-native TRPG platform, Rust/Python microservices API, 3D reconstruction application, ROS2 autonomous vehicle system, as well as engineering practice in control theory and computer vision.
paragraphs.para2: In terms of tech stack, I use Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and shadcn-UI for frontend/full-stack; build microservices with Rust (tokio/Axum) and Python FastAPI, combined with PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker and Github Action for CI/CD; practice LangChain/LangGraph, YOLOv5, OpenCV, Meta SAM2, Colmap and OpenMVS in AI and computer vision; and use ROS2, VINS-Fusion and Navigation2 with LQR and Luenberger methods in robotics and control.
paragraphs.para3: I strive to combine solid engineering practices with excellent user experience: continuously refining AI-native products, building scalable microservices and data infrastructure, exploring automated 3D generation and autonomous systems, and constantly improving performance and maintainability.
